sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Lumineth Realm-lords army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Lumineth Realm-lords units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Pick an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick a Battle Mount or Aelementor Type.
6.Pick any Battle Mount or Aelementor Upgrades.
7.Pick any other upgrades

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Champion of Hysh | 10 | 150
Aelven Lord | 30 | 250
Guardian of the Realms | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.text: To begin with, your hero has the following warscroll:

sections.name: Step 3 - Pick an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
VANARI COMMANDER
-0DP
Your hero gains the VANARI keyword, has a Save characteristic of 4+ and gains the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units
ECLIPSIAN WARSAGE
-4DP
Your hero gains the WIZARD (1), SCINARI and VANARI keywords, has a Save characteristic of 4+ and gains the following regiment options. In addition, replace your hero’s Hyshian Blade with:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Eclipsian Blade | 5 | 3+ | 4+ | 2 | 2
Regiment Options | Any LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units
ALARITH MOUNTAIN KEEPER
-4DP
Your hero gains the ALARITH and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following ability and regiment options:
Passive
IMMOVABLE DEFENDERS
Effect: If you depicted Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain this battle round, add 3 to the control scores of friendly ALARITH units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Regiment Options | Any ALARITH or VANARI units
HURAKAN WIND CHARMER
-4DP
Your hero gains the HURAKAN and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following ability and regiment options:
Passive
GALE-FORCE ARROWS
Effect: If you depicted Oreali, Rune of the Wind this battle round, ranged weapons used by friendly HURAKAN units have Crit (Auto-wound) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
Regiment Options | Any HURAKAN or VANARI units
YDRILAN RIVER SHAPER
-4DP
Your hero gains the YDRILAN and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following ability and regiment options:
End of Any Turn
FLOW WITH THE CURRENT
Declare: If you depicted Ydriliqi, Rune of the River this battle round, pick a friendly YDRILAN unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
Regiment Options | Any YDRILAN or VANARI units
SCINARI MAGE
-4DP
Your hero gains the SCINARI and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following ability and regiment options:
Your Hero Phase
7
SHINING BLADES
Declare: Pick a visible friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
KEYWORDS | SPELL
Regiment Options | Any VANARI units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability
-2DP
ELEMENTAL FOCUS
Effect: If this unit is ALARITH, replace each rune on your battle scripture with Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain.
If this unit is HURAKAN, replace each rune on your battle scripture with Oreali, Rune of the Wind.
If this unit is YDRILAN, replace each rune on your battle scripture with Ydriliqi, Rune of the River.
If this unit is SCINARI or VANARI, pick 1 of the runes above and replace each rune on your battle scripture with that rune.
Any Combat Phase
-2DP
DEFENSIVE EXEMPLAR
Effect: For the rest of the turn:
This unit has STRIKE-LAST.
If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
Passive
-4DP
MAGICAL APTITUDE
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
-4DP
WEALTH OF THE LAND
Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the phase.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+2DP
INTRANSIGENT PRIDE
Effect: This unit cannot use RETREAT abilities.
Passive
+2DP
ARCANE SENSITIVITY
Effect: Unmodified casting rolls for friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units wholly within 12" of this unit that contain 2 or more rolls of 1 or 2 are miscast. This unit cannot end a move within 5" of a MANIFESTATION.
Passive
+4DP
ALOOF
Effect: Roll a dice each time you declare a command for another friendly unit within 6" of this unit. On a 4+, unless you spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
Passive
+6DP
FLIGHTY
Effect: Other friendly units cannot use the ‘Redeploy’ command while this unit is within 9" of any enemy units.

sections.name: Step 5 - Pick a Battle Mount or Aelementor Type
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount or Aelementor Type for your hero.
Battle Mount
-6DP
LIGHTCOURSER: Loyal mounts to the Vanari elite, Lightcoursers can run at blinding speed even through difficult terrain.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Lightcourser’s Horns and Claws
Companion | 3 | 4+ | 3+ | 1 | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 14".
Change the Health characteristic to 7.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Designer’s Note: Picking an Aelementor Type changes your hero from an aelf to an aelementor. Therefore, your hero’s characteristics and weapons change significantly. If you choose the Symbiotic Protectors upgrade on the next page, however, then both aelf and aelementor go to battle as a pair, like Teclis and Celennar.
Aelementor Type
-10DP
SWIFT REALM SPIRIT: This capricious, flowing aelementor is ever on the move, slaying the greatest threats from afar and laying waste to lesser foes with the howling currents that swirl around it.
Non-VANARI, non-SCINARI only. Replace your hero’s weapons with the weapons below:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Aelementor Ranged Weapon
Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend), Shoot in Combat | 15" | 4 | 2+ | 3+ | 2 | D3
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Swirling Debris
Crit (Mortal) | 6 | 2+ | 4+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 14".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.
Replace the AELF keyword with the AELEMENTOR keyword.
Aelementor Type
-15DP
UNYIELDING REALM SPIRIT: On rare occasions, some of the most ancient spirits are awoken to defend their realm, assuming towering war-forms that allow them to wade through the enemy ranks with impunity and smash multiple foes with great sweeps of their chosen armament.
Non-VANARI, non-SCINARI only. Replace your hero’s weapons with the weapons below:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Aelementor Colossal Weapon | 5 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 4
Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Aelementor Colossal Weapon is 3.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero's warscroll:
Change the Save characteristic to 3+.
Change the Health characteristic to 14.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.
Replace the AELF keyword with the AELEMENTOR keyword.

sections.name: Step 6 - Pick any Battle Mount or Aelementor Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount or Aelementor Type, you can pick any number of Battle Mount or Aelementor Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Alpha Lightcourser
-1DP
CAVALRY only. Your hero’s Companion weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).
Symbiotic Protectors
-3DP
AELEMENTOR only. Your hero gains the AELF keyword and the Hyshian Blade weapon from the starting warscroll.
Swarm of Lesser Spirits
-5DP
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Awakened Realm Spirits
Crit (Mortal) | 10" | 10 | 4+ | 4+ | - | 1
Momentous Charge
-5DP
Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Any Charge Phase
MOMENTOUS CHARGE
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
Blasted by the Elements
-5DP
AELEMENTOR only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Any Combat Phase
BLASTED BY THE ELEMENTS
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE
Realms Manifest
-5DP
AELEMENTOR only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Deployment Phase
REALMS MANIFEST
Effect: Pick 1 of the following runes:
Ydriliqi, Rune of the River
Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain
Oreali, Rune of the Wind
For the rest of the battle, while a visible friendly unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
You are treated as having 1 additional instance of that rune depicted on your battle scripture for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of that rune depicted on your battle scripture.

sections.name: Step 7 - Pick any Other Upgrades
sections.text:
Pick any number of other upgrades for your hero. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Fly the Standard
-1DP
Add 1 to your hero’s Control characteristic.
Sharpened by Light
-2DP
The Rend characteristic of your hero’s Hyshian Blade is 2.
Shining Armour
-2DP
Your hero’s Save characteristic is 3+.
Skilfully Trained
-3DP
Pick 1 of your hero’s melee weapons. That weapon has Anti-X (+1 Rend), where X is 1 of the following keywords: INFANTRY, CAVALRY, MONSTER, WAR MACHINE, WIZARD or PRIEST.
Arcane Protection
-4DP
Your hero has WARD (5+).
Silver Bow
-4DP
INFANTRY or CAVALRY only. Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Silver Bow
Crit (Auto-wound) | 18" | 9 | 4+ | 4+ | 1 | 1
Lifted by Nature
-4DP
Add 2" to your hero’s Move characteristic. Your hero has FLY.
Forged in Sunmetal
-4DP
INFANTRY or CAVALRY only. Your hero’s non-Companion melee weapons gain Crit (Mortal).
Magical Form
-6DP
INFANTRY only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
MAGICAL FORM
Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
One with the Realms
-8DP
Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ONE WITH THE REALMS
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
Master of Aelven Sorcery
-6DP
WIZARD only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
ARCANE MASTERY
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.
Magical Brilliance
-8DP
WIZARD only. Your hero has WIZARD (2).

sections.name: Path of the Luminary
sections.text:
(LUMINETH REALM-LORDS HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
PRECISION STRIKES
Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
Passive
UNRAVEL MAGIC
Effect: Add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Any End of Any Turn
FLEET AND DEFT
Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through enemy models during that move.
Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit
STEADY MIND
Effect: Re-roll 1 of the dice in the casting roll.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
DISPLAY OF PROWESS
Effect: This unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
Passive
ENLIGHTENING PRESENCE
Effect: While friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units are wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to casting rolls for those units and add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ attacks.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Your Charge Phase
ICON OF VALOUR
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly LUMINETH REALM-LORDS units wholly within 12’ of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target(s), add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
Passive
ASCENDED FORM
Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, it is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) this unit and for the rest of the battle:
Ignore modifiers (positive and negative) to save rolls and ward rolls for this unit.
This unit has WARD (4+) and FLY.
This unit cannot be healed.

sections.name: Path of the Enlightened
sections.text:
(non-HERO LUMINETH REALM-LORDS unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Reaction: You declared the ‘Run’ ability for this unit
FLEET-FOOTED
Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
Passive
COURAGEOUS RESOLVE
Effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score while each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
REALMSHIFT
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
Passive
UNSHAKEABLE FOCUS
Effect: Ignore the effects of STRIKE-LAST on this unit.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BALANCED MANOEUVRES
Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.
Passive
ARTISAN ARMOUR
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BLINDING BRILLIANCE
Effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of abilities used by enemy units that are more than 9" away from it.
Passive
SWORN DEFENDERS
Effect: While this unit is wholly within the combat range of another friendly unit, both this unit and that friendly unit have WARD (5+).
